email_subject: Application - Marketing Technology & Web Platform Specialist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Technology & Web Platform Specialist role in Antwerp. I work where marketing, web technology and data meet: building and maintaining websites, handling structured data and technical SEO, and connecting the tools around them so the work runs smoothly.

Concrete examples: I built and now maintain a WordPress/Elementor site for a pharmacists' association with a consistent layout for roughly 600 member profile pages, and implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file for another site, followed by iterative technical audits. At Knowledge Experts I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo. Earlier, as a front-end developer, I built JavaScript/AngularJS features for a healthcare application.

Requirements, integrations, testing and releases are familiar ground. I'm fluent in English, improving my Dutch, and based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Technology & Web Platform Specialist position in Antwerp. Your description - owning the technical evolution of a public website while coordinating the MarTech landscape around it - describes the work I already do, at a smaller scale, and I'd like to do it inside a team with an international platform to look after.

In my freelance practice and at Episto I build and run websites and take care of everything around them: structure, content, structured data, integrations and the reporting that shows whether any of it worked. For a pharmacists' association I built and now maintain a WordPress/Elementor site with a consistent layout for roughly 600 member profile pages. For mirook.com I implemented JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, then ran iterative technical SEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. At Knowledge Experts I supported the team building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (an application gallery for 12,000 staff) - projects where requirements, data mapping between systems and validation of what went live mattered every day. Before that, as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor, I built features in JavaScript and AngularJS for a healthcare application, so I can read code and speak with developers in their own language.

My CMS background is WordPress rather than Drupal, and I won't claim production-level PHP. What I bring instead is JavaScript and front-end experience, hands-on work with integrations, data flows and APIs, a habit of testing and validating releases, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. I'm fluent in English and working on my Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and from Zwijndrecht I can be in Antwerp regularly.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

cv_highlights:
- Front-end development background: built and optimized JavaScript/AngularJS features for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor - able to review technical work and communicate effectively with developers
- Platform and integration coordination: supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (application gallery for 12,000 staff) at Knowledge Experts (KXP), 2024-2026
- Web platform management at scale: built and maintains a WordPress/Elementor site for a pharmacists' association with a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages, plus client websites and two Shopify stores
- Data flows, structured data and integrations: JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup, llms.txt, MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools, Python automation, and an Android app live on Google Play
- Testing, releases and reporting: iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, validation of live functionality against search-health metrics, and performance reporting with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs; English fluent, Dutch writing B1 / speaking A2+
